title: Humanitarian access improves
description: Scenario — not prediction: aid flow improves, access constraints ease, and coordination improves.
possibleOpportunities: More food, health, WASH, shelter, and education support.
regionalImplications: Regional logistics may become more important.
sectorImplications: Food, health, WASH, shelter, and education may all see increased support needs.
actionImplications: support verified humanitarian partners and local capacity

title: Access remains restricted
description: Scenario — not prediction: access, supplies, or movement remain constrained.
possibleOpportunities: Preparedness and prioritization can reduce secondary harm.
regionalImplications: Regional advocacy and logistics may face pressure.
actionImplications: support life-saving sectors and advocacy for humanitarian access

title: Regional escalation increases pressure
description: Scenario — not prediction: regional escalation increases uncertainty and may affect access, funding, movement, public anxiety, or misinformation.
assumptions: Public anxiety or misinformation may increase.
possibleOpportunities: Verified information and preparedness can reduce confusion.
regionalImplications: Regional systems may affect humanitarian flow and public discourse.
sectorImplications: All sectors may face higher uncertainty.
actionImplications: support verified sources, avoid speculation, prioritize humanitarian access and civilian protection
caveats: This is a scenario, not a claim that escalation will occur.

title: Education recovery begins
description: Scenario — not prediction: temporary learning expands, teacher support improves, and child protection pathways strengthen.
regionalImplications: Regional education and youth partnerships may become relevant.
sectorImplications: Education, protection, and peacebuilding link more closely.
actionImplications: support education in emergencies and verified child-protection actors

title: Digital and AI-enabled recovery expands
description: Scenario — not prediction: safe digital infrastructure, remote learning, translation, data systems, and AI tools become more available.
regionalImplications: Technology and youth futures connect to regional systems.
sectorImplications: Education, health, trust, and livelihoods may all be affected.
actionImplications: support safe, partner-reviewed civic technology and learning systems

title: Long-term social repair becomes possible
description: Scenario — not prediction: conditions allow sustained peacebuilding, civic capacity, and institution rebuilding.
assumptions: Sustained civic and peacebuilding work becomes possible.
Programs are locally validated and partner-mediated.
regionalImplications: Peace capacity may depend on broader regional trust, narratives, and institutions.
sectorImplications: Protection, education, youth leadership, and social cohesion become central recovery sectors.
actionImplications: support long-term peacebuilding, social cohesion, and leadership pathways
caveats: Scenario — not prediction; local validation required.

title: Public-health risk rises after WASH stress
description: Scenario — not prediction: water, sanitation, displacement, or health-system constraints increase disease-prevention concern.
regionalImplications: Public-health risks can connect to regional movement, climate, water, and health systems.
sectorImplications: WASH, health, shelter, and protection analysis must remain connected.
actionImplications: support verified WASH and health actors; do not give medical advice
caveats: Public health scenario, not diagnosis or local outbreak claim.
